frozen_before: any LoCoMo-10 scoring; LoCoMo stores were built but never queried or scored
definition: Vector recall's top 50 (relevance filter off), its first 20, re-scored by FastEmbed TextCrossEncoder 'Xenova/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2' (Apache-2.0, 92 MB) on each memory's first 512 characters, reordered by descending score with ties keeping vector order, top 10. Implemented by make_rerank_arm in scripts/locomo_heldout.py, reproducing scripts/prototype_rerank.py.
product_scope: opt-in recall setting only; the default recall path is unchanged
tuned_on: LongMemEval-S development 180 (174 with evidence): complete evidence 121 -> 138 (multi-session 18 -> 28, temporal 26 -> 29, single-session-assistant 22 -> 20)
synthetic retrieval_v1, retrieval_v2, retrieval_v3: all pass; v3 distractor leak exactly at the 0.10 gate. v3 was used as a gate in selection and is not independent evidence
selection: best variant passing every synthetic gate among 5 models x 3 depths (full text) and MiniLM-L6 x 4 truncations x 3 depths; all depth-30/50 variants failed retrieval_v3 on distractor leak
held_out: LoCoMo-10, categories 1-4 with parseable evidence, one paired look (vector baseline and candidate in the same pass), aggregate only
pass_rule_meaning: candidate complete evidence >= baseline + ceil(2% of scored questions); in every category 1-4 the candidate loses at most floor(1% of that category's questions) versus baseline; per-query latency (recall plus re-rank, measured in the same look) adds at most 500 ms median and 750 ms p95 over vector recall. Latency limits are an owner decision of 2026-10-24 for an opt-in setting; the plan's +3 ms limit still governs any default-path change. Applied mechanically by verdict() and recorded in the ledger.
if_passed: add the re-ranker to the product as an opt-in recall setting, re-run all synthetic gates and the test suite through the product code path, prove its reordering properties in Rocq, and document the latency cost
if_failed: record the result; the re-ranker does not ship; LoCoMo keeps its remaining looks
